verdict.rationale: Recurly RevRec automates ASC 606/IFRS 15 revenue recognition with multi-currency support and automated contract modifications, and data export/import docs mention exporting revenue recognition reports, suggesting some GL-adjacent data flow. However, no evidence names or documents direct sync/integration with QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite, or any 'no CSV' automated GL posting workflow. Missing for 10: named ERP connectors (QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite), documentation of automated invoice/payment sync avoiding manual CSV export, and any third-party corroboration of GL close automation.
